Creation.modeHint: Creation shows the points and the cap for each ability. Free leaves the fields open, with no counters.
Creation.undefinedBudget: The budget for Rank {rank} has not been set yet.
Creation.askGM: Ask the Narrator to set it.
Creation.bonusHint: Adjustments from Origin, Occupation, traits or the Narrator. They can be negative.

Budget.title: Ability budget by Rank
Budget.menuHint: Points to spend and the cap for each ability, by Rank. The sheets' creation mode uses it.
Budget.hint: Leave blank what has not been set yet. Rank 1 comes filled in; check the others in your book.
Budget.gmOnly: Only the Narrator can set the budget.

strictBudget.name: Stop the + button at the limit
strictBudget.hint: On: in creation mode, the + button stops when the ability reaches the cap or the points run out. Off: the sheet only warns.

Appearance.title: Sheet appearance
Appearance.hint: Applies only to you, in this browser. Each player picks their own.

uiTheme.name: Sheet theme
uiTheme.hint: Light: a light background, like the printed page. Dark: the same design on a dark background.

uiTextSize.name: Text size
uiTextSize.hint: Makes all the letters on the sheet bigger.
